definitions.gloss: first-come; arriving first; in order of arrival
definitions.explanation: refers to a system where priority is given based on order of arrival; commonly used for limited offers or events

examples.japanese: {先着|せんちゃく}{五十名様|ごじゅうめいさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧。
{先着|せんちゃく}{順|じゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けます→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We will accept applications on a first-come, first-served basis.

examples.japanese: {先着|せんちゃく}{百名|ひゃくめい}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: A special sale limited to the first 100 customers has begun.

notes:
FORMS:
{先|せん} (first, ahead) + ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (arriving) → arriving first

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先着|せんちゃく}{順|じゅん} (in order of arrival)
- {先着|せんちゃく}〜{名|めい}/⟦{名様|めいさま}→名様：30700_meisama⟧ (first ~ people)
- {先着|せんちゃく}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (limited to first arrivals)
- {先着|せんちゃく}⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧ (first-come bonus)

USAGE:
Commonly seen in:
- Promotional campaigns ({先着|せんちゃく}○{名|めい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧)
- Event registrations
- Limited sales
- Restaurant seating

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{早|はや}い{者|もの}{勝|が}ち→早い者勝ち：30780_hayaimonogachi⟧ (first come, first served - more casual)
- ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧ (lottery - alternative allocation method)
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧ (reservation priority)
